question: how many losses can we actually realize?

answer_now.context: embedded GAINS on the same book ~+$36.8k; the book is UP 14.7% since May, which is exactly why there is almost nothing to harvest

why_so_little: TLH capacity is a function of (volatility x basis freshness x lot granularity). A book that has appreciated has no harvestable loss BY CONSTRUCTION. Our $5M is still ~68% undeployed - the loss bank cannot exist before the basis exists.

forward_capacity_model.method: 35-45% of a 30-40 name book red at a given quarter-end, avg depth of the red cohort 12-18% (idiosyncratic vol 35-45% on the smallcap/court-band sleeve)

constraints: wash-sale: 31 days, and the Parametric singles + GOOGL are the household's wash surface - any IBKR name overlapping Parametric holdings is contaminated
$3,000/yr ordinary-income offset cap; losses beyond that only offset CAPITAL gains or carry forward indefinitely
harvesting requires SELLING - each harvest is a real portfolio decision (rotation partner or 31-day absence), never free
ST vs LT character: losses harvested <12mo are ST (offset ST gains first) - our whole book is <5 months old so ALL current losses are short-term
actionable_now: PL (-$2,688) is the only position where the harvest is material AND the thesis is impaired (gov-revenue sat unverified, -18% from basis) - candidate for a genuine sell-and-rotate, not a wash-trade
the JP sleeve losses are FX-driven noise on positions we want - do NOT harvest
the QCOM/FAF option marks are not harvestable (short options: no loss until closed/expired)
conclusion: ~$5.2k realizable today, of which ~$2.7k (PL) is thesis-supported. The TLH mandate is a FORWARD program - it needs the $5M deployed at market basis first; capacity then scales to roughly $240-460k of annual harvest at full deployment, worth $84-162k of tax value. Deployment IS the harvest engine.
